name: Twin primes
description: Primes belonging to at least one twin-prime pair. Each prime is included once.

name: Semiprimes
description: Products of two primes, allowing equal primes.

name: Lesser twin primes
description: Primes p for which p + 2 is prime. Jumps go to the next lesser twin prime.

name: Sums of two squares
description: Nonnegative integers representable as a sum of two integer squares, including 0.

name: Not divisible by 3
description: Positive integers not divisible by 3: a(n) = floor((3n − 1)/2).

name: Primes and twice primes
description: The sorted union of primes and twice primes.

name: Triangle packing numbers
description: A(n,4,3). Strictly increasing tail from OEIS n = 4; the initial 0, 0, 1 prefix is omitted.

name: Centered square numbers
description: a(n) = 2n(n + 1) + 1. Positive-index tail n ≥ 1; a(0) = 1 is omitted.

name: Binary-insertion sorting numbers
description: Worst-case binary-insertion comparison counts. Original OEIS indices retained; a(1) = 0 is unclassified.

name: Beatty: 2 + √2
description: a(n) = floor(n(2 + √2)), evaluated using integer square roots.

name: Evil numbers
description: Nonnegative integers with even binary popcount, including 0.

name: Residues 2, 4, 8, 16 modulo 20
description: Positive integers congruent to 2, 4, 8 or 16 modulo 20.

name: Decimal palindromes
description: Base-10 palindromes in increasing order. Original OEIS indices retained, including a(1) = 0 in the unclassified count.

name: Primes ≡ 1 (mod 4)
description: Primes of the form 4m + 1. The jump goes to the next prime in this subsequence.

name: Primes ≡ 3 (mod 4)
description: Primes of the form 4m + 3. The jump goes to the next prime in this subsequence.

name: Pronic numbers
description: Products of consecutive positive integers, a(n) = n(n + 1). The OEIS entry also includes 0.

name: Primes ≡ 1 (mod 6)
description: Primes congruent to 1 modulo 6. Jumps use consecutive terms of this subsequence.

name: Squares plus one
description: a(n) = n² + 1. Positive-index tail n ≥ 1; a(0) = 1 is omitted.

name: Quarter-squares
description: a(n) = floor(n²/4), strictly increasing tail n ≥ 2. Original OEIS indices retained; a(0) = a(1) = 0 are omitted.

name: Composite numbers
description: Positive composite integers, beginning 4, 6, 8, 9, 10, …
